license_required.quote: No person shall practice as a dental hygienist in this state until such person has passed a written and a clinical examination conducted or approved by the board.

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the Georgia Board of Dentistry.

name.quote: "Board" means the Georgia Board of Dentistry.

type.quote: The board shall perform such duties and possess and exercise such powers, relative to the protection of the public health and the control and regulation of the practice of dentistry as this chapter prescribes and confers upon it.

moral_character_required.quote: No person shall be entitled to or be issued such license as set out in Code Section 43-11-70 unless such person is at least 18 years of age, of good moral character

degree_required.value: Doctor of Dental Surgery (D.D.S.) or Doctor of Dental Medicine (D.M.D.) degree from an accredited dental school
degree_required.quote: Applicants for a license to practice dentistry must have received a doctor of dental surgery (D.D.S.) degree or a doctor of dental medicine (D.M.D.) degree from a dental school approved by the board and accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association (ADA) or its successor agency

accrediting_body.value: Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association (ADA)
accrediting_body.quote: accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association (ADA) or its successor agency

exams.name: Clinical examination
exams.quote: all applicants must pass a clinical examination approved by the board

exams.name: Jurisprudence examination
exams.quote: a jurisprudence examination on the laws of this state and rules and regulations as they relate to the practice of dentistry as established or approved by the board, which shall be administered in the English language

interval_years.quote: Every person licensed by the board to practice dentistry shall register biennially on the renewal date set by the board

required.quote: The board shall be authorized to require persons seeking renewal of a dental license under this chapter to complete board approved continuing education of not less than 40 hours biennially.

value: legal ethics and professionalism in the practice of dentistry
unprofessional conduct relating to sexual intimacy, abuse, misconduct, or exploitation
legislative updates and changes to the laws relating to the practice of dentistry
topical_requirements.quote: continuing education requirements for dentists shall include legal ethics and professionalism in the practice of dentistry, which shall include, but shall not be limited to, education and training regarding professional boundaries; unprofessional conduct relating to the commission of acts of sexual intimacy, abuse, misconduct, or exploitation with regard to the practice of dentistry; legislative updates and changes to the laws relating to the practice of dentistry and rules, policies, and advisory opinions and rulings issued by the board; professional conduct and ethics; proper billing practices; professional liability; and risk management.

available.quote: The board may issue, in its discretion, without examination, a teacher's or instructor's license to a dentist

requirements.value: Applicants for provisional license by credentials must have been in full-time clinical practice or full-time faculty for five years immediately preceding the application and must hold an active dental license in good standing from another state. Must pass clinical examination given by state or regional testing agency and jurisprudence examination.
requirements.quote: Applicants must have been in full-time clinical practice, as defined by rules and regulations established by the board; full-time faculty, as defined by board rule and regulation; or a combination of both for the five years immediately preceding the date of the application and must hold an active dental license in good standing from another state.

exists.quote: The board shall perform such duties and possess and exercise such powers, relative to the protection of the public health and the control and regulation of the practice of dentistry as this chapter prescribes and confers upon it.

national_certification.value: American Board of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery (ABOS), American Association of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgeons, American Dental Society of Anesthesiology
national_certification.quote: Is a diplomate of the American Board of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery, is a member of the American Association of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgeons, or is a fellow of the American Dental Society of Anesthesiology

national_association.quote: Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall practice as a dental hygienist in this state until such person has passed a written and a clinical examination conducted or approved by the board.

credential_type.quote: The board shall issue licenses and license certificates as dental hygienists to those persons who have passed the examination in a manner satisfactory to the board

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall practice as a dental hygienist in this state until such person has passed a written and a clinical examination conducted or approved by the board.

title_protection.quote: Any person who engages in the practice of dental hygiene without first having obtained a license therefor shall be guilty of a misdemeanor.

scope_protection.quote: Any person, firm, partnership, corporation, or other entity who practices dentistry in this state without obtaining a license to practice from the board shall be guilty of a felony

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to demonstrate the qualifications or standards for a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to demonstrate the qualifications or standards for a license contained in this chapter or in the rules and regulations issued by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly made misleading, deceptive, untrue, or fraudulent representations in the practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly made misleading, deceptive, untrue, or fraudulent representations in the practice of dentistry or on any document connected therewith; or practiced fraud or deceit or intentionally made any false statement in obtaining a license to practice dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Been convicted of any felony or of any crime involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been convicted of any felony or of any crime involving moral turpitude in the courts of this state or any other state, territory, or country or in the courts of the United States

disciplinary_grounds.description: Been arrested, charged, and sentenced for felony or crime involving moral turpitude with nolo contendere plea or first offender treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been arrested, charged, and sentenced for the commission of any felony, or any crime involving moral turpitude, where: A plea of nolo contendere was entered to the charge; First offender treatment without adjudication of guilt pursuant to the charge was granted; or An adjudication or sentence was otherwise withheld or not entered on the charge.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had license revoked, suspended, or annulled by another state dental authority
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Had his or her license to practice dentistry revoked, suspended, or annulled by any lawful licensing dental authority other than the board; or had other disciplinary action taken against him or her by any lawful licensing dental authority other than the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in unprofessional, immoral, unethical, deceptive, or deleterious conduct harmful to the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in any unprofessional, immoral, unethical, deceptive, or deleterious conduct or practice harmful to the public, which conduct or practice materially affects the fitness of the licensee or applicant to practice dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in practice of dentistry as employee of unlicensed individual or improper business entity
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in the practice of dentistry as an employee of any individual not licensed to practice dentistry in this state or engaged in the practice of dentistry as an officer or employee of any corporation other than one organized and existing pursuant to Chapter 10 of Title 14, "The Georgia Professional Association Act," or Chapter 7 of Title 14, the "Georgia Professional Corporation Act"

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly performed any act which aids, assists, procures, advises, or encourages unlicensed practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly performed any act which in any way aids, assists, procures, advises, or encourages any unlicensed person or any licensee whose license has been suspended or revoked by the board to practice dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated a statute, law, or rule or regulation relating to the practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated a statute, law, or any rule or regulation of this state, any other state, the board, the United States, or any other lawful authority which statute, law, or rule or regulation relates to or in part regulates the practice of dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Been adjudged mentally incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been adjudged mentally incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction within or outside this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Displayed an inability to practice dentistry with reasonable skill and safety to patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Displayed an inability to practice dentistry with reasonable skill and safety to patients or has become unable to practice dentistry with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness, use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or any other type of material

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in excessive prescribing or administering of drugs or treatment detrimental to patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in the excessive prescribing or administering of drugs or treatment or the use of diagnostic procedures which are detrimental to the patient as determined by the customary practice and standards of the local community of licensees; or knowingly prescribed controlled drug substances or any other medication without a legitimate dental purpose

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly made fraudulent, misleading, or deceptive statement in advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly made any fraudulent, misleading, or deceptive statement in any form of advertising or made any statement in any advertisement concerning the quality of the dental services rendered by that dentist

definition_quote.value: "Dentistry" means the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, or treatment, or any combination thereof, whether using surgical or nonsurgical procedures, of diseases, disorders, or conditions, or any combination thereof, of the oral cavity, maxillofacial area, or the adjacent and associated structures, or any combination thereof, and their impact on the human body provided by a dentist, within the scope of his or her education, training, and experience, in accordance with the ethics of the profession and applicable law
definition_quote.quote: "Dentistry" means the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, or treatment, or any combination thereof, whether using surgical or nonsurgical procedures, of diseases, disorders, or conditions, or any combination thereof, of the oral cavity, maxillofacial area, or the adjacent and associated structures, or any combination thereof, and their impact on the human body provided by a dentist, within the scope of his or her education, training, and experience, in accordance with the ethics of the profession and applicable law

methods_authorized.quote: the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, or treatment, or any combination thereof, whether using surgical or nonsurgical procedures

drug_authority.value: Dentists may prescribe controlled drug substances and other medications for legitimate dental purposes
drug_authority.quote: knowingly prescribed controlled drug substances or any other medication without a legitimate dental purpose

sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: No dentist licensed and practicing in the State of Georgia shall administer either single or multiple pharmacologic agents by oral, parenteral, enteral, transdermal, or transmucosal route that renders a patient to a state of conscious sedation

sedation_permit_onsite_inspection_requir.quote: The board or its appointed designee may, upon reasonable notice, make on-site inspections of the facility, equipment, and personnel of a dentist issued a permit under this Code section to determine if the standards of paragraph (2) of subsection (b) of this Code section are being maintained.

specialist_license_available.quote: The board is authorized to provide by rule or regulation for definitions of the several dental specialties.

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: "Direct supervision" means that a licensed dentist is in the dental office or treatment facility, personally diagnoses the condition to be treated, personally authorizes the procedure and remains in the dental office or treatment facility while the procedure is being performed by the dental hygienist, and before dismissal of the patient, examines the patient. "General supervision" means that a licensed dentist has authorized the delegable duties of a licensed dental hygienist but does not require that a licensed dentist be present when such duties are performed.

collaborative_agreement_max_hygienists_p.quote: A licensed dentist may only authorize up to four licensed dental hygienists to provide dental hygiene services pursuant to subsection (g), (h), or (i) of this Code section at any one time.

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: Engaged in the practice of dentistry as an employee of any individual not licensed to practice dentistry in this state or engaged in the practice of dentistry as an officer or employee of any corporation other than one organized and existing pursuant to Chapter 10 of Title 14, "The Georgia Professional Association Act," or Chapter 7 of Title 14, the "Georgia Professional Corporation Act," or engaged in the practice of dentistry as an employee, manager, or member of any limited liability company organized and existing pursuant to Chapter 11 of Title 14 or a limited liability partnership pursuant to Chapter 8 of Title 14 other than one in which all members are licensed dentists and all professional services and professional judgment decisions are delivered by and made by licensed dentists

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: After 1988, as a prerequisite for license renewal, dentists shall furnish satisfactory evidence of current certification in cardiopulmonary resuscitation as may be defined by rule or regulation of the board.
